title: Learning Order Forest for Qualitative-Attribute Data Clustering
summary: Clustering is a fundamental approach to understanding data patterns, wherein the intuitive Euclidean distance space is commonly adopted. However, this is not the case for implicit cluster distributions reflected by qualitative attribute values, e.g., the nominal values of attributes like symptoms, marital status, etc. This paper, therefore, discovered a tree-like distance structure to flexibly represent the local order relationship among intra-attribute qualitative values. That is, treating a value as the vertex of the tree allows to capture rich order relationships among the vertex value and the others. To obtain the trees in a clustering-friendly form, a joint learning mechanism is proposed to iteratively obtain more appropriate tree structures and clusters. It turns out that the latent distance space of the whole dataset can be well-represented by a forest consisting of the learned trees. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the joint learning adapts the forest to the clustering task to yield accurate results. Comparisons of 10 counterparts on 12 real benchmark datasets with significance tests verify the superiority of the proposed method.

AI.title_translation: 学习定序森林用于定性属性数据聚类
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种学习定序森林的方法，用于对定性属性数据进行聚类，通过发现树状距离结构和联合学习机制，有效处理了传统欧几里得距离在定性数据上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统聚类方法常用的欧几里得距离空间不适用于反映定性属性值（如症状、婚姻状况等名义值）的隐式聚类分布，因此需要一种新的方法来处理定性属性数据的聚类。
AI.method: 本文发现了一种树状距离结构来灵活表示属性内定性值之间的局部顺序关系，将值视为树的顶点以捕获丰富的顺序关系。提出了一种联合学习机制，迭代地获取更合适的树结构和聚类。整个数据集的潜在距离空间由学习到的树组成的森林表示。
AI.result: 广泛的实验证明，联合学习机制使森林适应聚类任务，从而产生准确的结果。在12个真实基准数据集上与10种对应方法的比较，并通过显著性检验验证了所提出方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的联合学习机制能够使定序森林适应聚类任务，从而在定性属性数据聚类中获得准确且优越的结果。
AI.translation: 聚类是理解数据模式的基本方法，其中直观的欧几里得距离空间被普遍采用。然而，这对于由定性属性值（例如症状、婚姻状况等属性的名义值）反映的隐式聚类分布来说并非如此。因此，本文发现了一种树状距离结构，以灵活表示属性内定性值之间的局部顺序关系。也就是说，将一个值视为树的顶点可以捕获该顶点值与其它值之间丰富的顺序关系。为了以有利于聚类的形式获得这些树，本文提出了一种联合学习机制，以迭代地获得更合适的树结构和聚类。结果表明，整个数据集的潜在距离空间可以由学习到的树组成的森林很好地表示。广泛的实验表明，联合学习使森林适应聚类任务，从而产生准确的结果。在12个真实基准数据集上与10种对应方法的比较，并通过显著性检验验证了所提出方法的优越性。
AI.summary: 针对定性属性数据（如名义值）聚类中传统欧几里得距离的局限性，本文提出了一种学习定序森林的方法。该方法通过发现树状的距离结构来表示属性内定性值之间的局部顺序关系，并引入了一种联合学习机制，迭代地优化树结构和聚类。实验证明，该方法能有效表示整个数据集的潜在距离空间，并能适应聚类任务以产生准确结果，在多个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 定性属性数据, 聚类, 定序森林, 树状距离结构, 联合学习
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了树状距离结构来处理定性属性数据中复杂的局部顺序关系，并引入了联合学习机制来共同优化树结构和聚类，从而克服了传统距离度量在定性数据上的不足，为定性数据聚类提供了一种有效且新颖的解决方案。

title: Beyond Cross-Validation: Adaptive Parameter Selection for Kernel-Based Gradient Descents
summary: This paper proposes a novel parameter selection strategy for kernel-based gradient descent (KGD) algorithms, integrating bias-variance analysis with the splitting method. We introduce the concept of empirical effective dimension to quantify iteration increments in KGD, deriving an adaptive parameter selection strategy that is implementable. Theoretical verifications are provided within the framework of learning theory. Utilizing the recently developed integral operator approach, we rigorously demonstrate that KGD, equipped with the proposed adaptive parameter selection strategy, achieves the optimal generalization error bound and adapts effectively to different kernels, target functions, and error metrics. Consequently, this strategy showcases significant advantages over existing parameter selection methods for KGD.

AI.title_translation: 超越交叉验证：核梯度下降的自适应参数选择
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的核梯度下降（KGD）算法的自适应参数选择策略，通过理论验证和实验证明其能达到最优泛化误差界，并优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有核梯度下降（KGD）算法的参数选择方法存在局限性，需要一种更有效、更具适应性的策略。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新的参数选择策略，将偏差-方差分析与分裂方法相结合。引入经验有效维度来量化KGD中的迭代增量，并导出了可实现的自适应参数选择策略。利用积分算子方法进行理论验证。
AI.result: KGD配备所提出的自适应参数选择策略，实现了最优泛化误差界，并能有效适应不同的核、目标函数和误差度量。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的自适应参数选择策略在KGD的参数选择方面比现有方法具有显著优势。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种针对核梯度下降（KGD）算法的新型参数选择策略，该策略将偏差-方差分析与分裂方法相结合。我们引入了经验有效维度的概念来量化KGD中的迭代增量，并推导出了一个可实现的自适应参数选择策略。在学习理论框架内提供了理论验证。利用最近发展的积分算子方法，我们严格证明了配备所提出的自适应参数选择策略的KGD能够实现最优的泛化误差界，并能有效地适应不同的核、目标函数和误差度量。因此，该策略相对于现有KGD参数选择方法展现出显著优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对核梯度下降（KGD）算法的新型自适应参数选择策略。该策略结合了偏差-方差分析和分裂方法，并引入经验有效维度来指导参数选择。理论验证表明，该策略使KGD达到了最优泛化误差界，并能有效适应多种情况，显著优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 核梯度下降, 参数选择, 自适应策略, 泛化误差, 偏差-方差分析
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了将偏差-方差分析与经验有效维度相结合的自适应参数选择策略，为核梯度下降算法提供了一种理论上更优、实践上更具适应性的解决方案，超越了传统的交叉验证方法。其理论严谨性通过积分算子方法得到了验证，对学习理论领域具有重要贡献。

title: Surprisal-Rényi Free Energy
summary: The forward and reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergences arise as limiting objectives in learning and inference yet induce markedly different inductive biases that cannot be explained at the level of expectations alone. In this work, we introduce the Surprisal-Rényi Free Energy (SRFE), a log-moment-based functional of the likelihood ratio that lies outside the class of $f$-divergences. We show that SRFE recovers forward and reverse KL divergences as singular endpoint limits and derive local expansions around both limits in which the variance of the log-likelihood ratio appears as a first-order correction. This reveals an explicit mean-variance tradeoff governing departures from KL-dominated regimes. We further establish a Gibbs-type variational characterization of SRFE as the unique minimizer of a weighted sum of KL divergences and prove that SRFE directly controls large deviations of excess code-length via Chernoff-type bounds, yielding a precise Minimum Description Length interpretation. Together, these results identify SRFE as a variance- and tail-sensitive free-energy functional that clarifies the geometric and large-deviation structure underlying forward and reverse KL limits, without unifying or subsuming distinct learning frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文引入了惊奇-雷尼自由能（SRFE），这是一种基于对数矩的似然比泛函，它恢复了前向和反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度作为奇异端点极限，并揭示了控制偏离KL主导机制的均值-方差权衡。SRFE还具有吉布斯型变分特性和最小描述长度（MDL）解释，作为一种对方差和尾部敏感的自由能泛函，它阐明了KL极限下的几何和大偏差结构。
AI.motivation: 前向和反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度在学习和推理中作为极限目标出现，但它们引起了截然不同的归纳偏差，这些偏差不能仅在期望水平上解释。因此，需要一个新的框架来理解这些差异。
AI.method: 本文引入了惊奇-雷尼自由能（SRFE），这是一种不属于f-散度类别的基于对数矩的似然比泛函。研究人员推导了SRFE在KL散度极限附近的局部展开式，并建立了SRFE的吉布斯型变分特征。此外，他们证明了SRFE通过切尔诺夫型界限直接控制超额码长的大偏差。
AI.result: SRFE将前向和反向KL散度恢复为奇异端点极限。在这些极限附近的局部展开中，对数似然比的方差作为一阶修正出现，揭示了控制偏离KL主导机制的显式均值-方差权衡。SRFE被确立为KL散度加权和的唯一最小化器，并被证明通过切尔诺夫型界限直接控制超额码长的大偏差，从而产生了精确的最小描述长度（MDL）解释。
AI.conclusion: SRFE被确定为一种对均值、方差和尾部敏感的自由能泛函，它澄清了前向和反向KL极限背后的几何和大偏差结构，而无需统一或包含不同的学习框架。
AI.translation: 前向和反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度作为学习和推理中的极限目标出现，但它们引起了截然不同的归纳偏差，这些偏差不能仅在期望水平上解释。在这项工作中，我们引入了惊奇-雷尼自由能（SRFE），这是一种不属于f-散度类别的基于对数矩的似然比泛函。我们表明，SRFE将前向和反向KL散度恢复为奇异端点极限，并推导了围绕这两个极限的局部展开式，其中对数似然比的方差作为一阶修正出现。这揭示了控制偏离KL主导机制的显式均值-方差权衡。我们进一步建立了SRFE的吉布斯型变分特征，作为KL散度加权和的唯一最小化器，并证明SRFE通过切尔诺夫型界限直接控制超额码长的大偏差，从而产生了精确的最小描述长度解释。总而言之，这些结果将SRFE识别为一种对均值、方差和尾部敏感的自由能泛函，它阐明了前向和反向KL极限背后的几何和大偏差结构，而无需统一或包含不同的学习框架。
AI.summary: 本文引入了惊奇-雷尼自由能（SRFE），这是一种超越f-散度类别的基于对数矩的似然比泛函。SRFE能够恢复前向和反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度作为其奇异端点极限，并通过局部展开揭示了控制KL主导机制偏离的均值-方差权衡。此外，SRFE具有吉布斯型变分特性，是KL散度加权和的唯一最小化器，并通过切尔诺夫型界限提供了超额码长大偏差的最小描述长度（MDL）解释。SRFE被证明是一种对均值、方差和尾部敏感的自由能泛函，有助于理解KL极限的几何和大偏差结构。
AI.keywords: 惊奇-雷尼自由能, Kullback-Leibler散度, 自由能, 大偏差, 最小描述长度
AI.comments: 本文引入了一种新的自由能泛函SRFE，它在理论上具有创新性，因为它超越了传统的f-散度类别，并能够连接并解释KL散度的行为。其对均值-方差权衡的揭示以及与最小描述长度（MDL）的联系，为理解学习和推理中的归纳偏差提供了新的视角和工具。这项工作对于信息论和机器学习的理论基础研究具有重要意义。

title: Scalable Contrastive Causal Discovery under Unknown Soft Interventions
summary: Observational causal discovery is only identifiable up to the Markov equivalence class. While interventions can reduce this ambiguity, in practice interventions are often soft with multiple unknown targets. In many realistic scenarios, only a single intervention regime is observed. We propose a scalable causal discovery model for paired observational and interventional settings with shared underlying causal structure and unknown soft interventions. The model aggregates subset-level PDAGs and applies contrastive cross-regime orientation rules to construct a globally consistent maximal PDAG under Meek closure, enabling generalization to both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings. Theoretically, we prove that our model is sound with respect to a restricted $Ψ$ equivalence class induced solely by the information available in the subset-restricted setting. We further show that the model asymptotically recovers the corresponding identifiable PDAG and can orient additional edges compared to non-contrastive subset-restricted methods. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate improved causal structure recovery, generalization to unseen graphs with held-out causal mechanisms, and scalability to larger graphs, with ablations supporting the theoretical results.

AI.title_translation: 未知软干预下的可扩展对比因果发现
AI.tldr: 针对观测数据和具有未知软干预的干预数据，我们提出了一种新的、可扩展的对比学习模型，它能聚合子集信息并利用跨方案比较来准确地确定因果方向，从而得到一个一致的最大 PDAG，并在实验中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 观测因果发现只能识别到马尔可夫等价类，而实际中的干预通常是软的且具有多个未知目标，通常只观察到一个干预方案。需要一个模型来解决这种在配对观测和干预数据（具有共享底层结构和未知软干预）下的因果发现问题。
AI.method: 模型聚合了子集级别的部分有向无环图（PDAGs），并应用对比式的跨方案（cross-regime）定向规则来构建一个全局一致的、在 MeekClosure 下的最大 PDAG。
AI.result: 证明了模型相对于仅由子集限制设置中可用信息引起的受限 $\Psi$ 等价类是可靠的，并且渐近地恢复了可识别的 PDAG，相比于非对比的子集限制方法可以定向更多的边。
AI.conclusion: 该模型在合成数据上展现了改进的因果结构恢复能力，对未见图的泛化能力，以及对更大图的可扩展性。消融实验支持了理论结果。
AI.translation: 观测因果发现仅能识别到马尔可夫等价类。虽然干预可以减少这种模糊性，但在实践中干预通常是软的，具有多个未知目标。在许多现实场景中，只观察到一个干预方案。我们提出了一个可扩展的因果发现模型，用于配对的观测和干预设置，这些设置具有共享的底层因果结构和未知的软干预。该模型聚合了子集级别的 PDAG 并应用对比的跨方案定向规则，以构建一个在 MeekClosure 下全局一致的最大 PDAG，从而能够泛化到具有分布内和分布外设置。理论上，我们证明了我们的模型相对于仅由子集限制设置中可用信息引起的受限 $\Psi$ 等价类是可靠的。我们进一步证明了该模型渐近地恢复了相应的可识别 PDAG，并且相比于非对比的子集限制方法可以定向额外的边。在合成数据上的实验证明了改进的因果结构恢复、对具有遗漏因果机制的未见图的泛化能力，以及对更大图的可扩展性，消融实验支持了理论结果。
AI.summary: 针对观测数据固有的马尔可夫等价性限制，以及实际中常见的具有未知目标的软干预场景，本文提出了一种可扩展的因果发现模型。该模型用于处理配对的观测和干预数据，通过聚合子集级别的 PDAG 并应用对比学习的跨方案定向规则，最终构建出一个全局一致的最大 PDAG，理论上证明了其可靠性，并在实验中展示了优于现有方法的结构恢复和泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 因果发现, 软干预, 对比学习, 结构学习, PDAG
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个可扩展的模型来处理带有未知软干预的配对观测和干预数据，并利用对比学习的跨方案定向规则来构建全局一致的结构。其重要性在于解决了现实中干预目标不明确的常见问题。局限性在于理论证明是针对受限的 $\Psi$ 等价类，而非完整的因果结构。

title: Stringology-Based Motif Discovery from EEG Signals: an ADHD Case Study
summary: We propose a novel computational framework for analyzing electroencephalography (EEG) time series using methods from stringology, the study of efficient algorithms for string processing, to systematically identify and characterize recurrent temporal patterns in neural signals. The primary aim is to introduce quantitative measures to understand neural signal dynamics, with the present findings serving as a proof-of-concept. The framework adapts order-preserving matching (OPM) and Cartesian tree matching (CTM) to detect temporal motifs that preserve relative ordering and hierarchical structure while remaining invariant to amplitude scaling. This approach provides a temporally precise representation of EEG dynamics that complements traditional spectral and global complexity analyses. To evaluate its utility, we applied the framework to multichannel EEG recordings from individuals with attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) and matched controls using a publicly available dataset. Highly recurrent, group-specific motifs were extracted and quantified using both OPM and CTM. The ADHD group exhibited significantly higher motif frequencies, suggesting increased repetitiveness in neural activity. OPM analysis revealed shorter motif lengths and greater gradient instability in ADHD, reflected in larger mean and maximal inter-sample amplitude changes. CTM analysis further demonstrated reduced hierarchical complexity in ADHD, characterized by shallower tree structures and fewer hierarchical levels despite comparable motif lengths. These findings suggest that ADHD-related EEG alterations involve systematic differences in the structure, stability, and hierarchical organization of recurrent temporal patterns. The proposed stringology-based motif framework provides a complementary computational tool with potential applications for objective biomarker development in neurodevelopmental disorders.

AI.title_translation: 基于字符串学的脑电信号基序发现：一项ADHD案例研究
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于字符串学的新型计算框架，用于分析脑电信号以识别重复时间模式。通过对ADHD患者的案例研究，发现ADHD组的基序频率更高，OPM显示基序更短、梯度不稳定性更大，CTM显示分层复杂性降低。该框架有望用于神经发育障碍的生物标志物开发。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在引入定量措施来理解神经信号动力学，并系统地识别和表征神经信号中重复出现的时间模式，以补充传统的频谱和全局复杂性分析，并作为概念验证。
AI.method: 研究提出了一种利用字符串学方法分析脑电（EEG）时间序列的计算框架。该框架采用保序匹配（OPM）和笛卡尔树匹配（CTM）来检测保留相对顺序和分层结构且对幅度缩放不变的时间基序。该方法应用于多通道EEG记录，并从ADHD患者和对照组中提取并量化了高度重复的组特异性基序。
AI.result: ADHD组表现出显著更高的基序频率，表明神经活动重复性增加。OPM分析揭示了ADHD患者的基序长度更短，梯度不稳定性更大。CTM分析进一步表明ADHD患者的分层复杂性降低，表现为树结构更浅和分层级别更少。
AI.conclusion: ADHD相关的EEG改变涉及复发时间模式的结构、稳定性以及分层组织方面的系统性差异。所提出的基于字符串学的基序框架提供了一种互补的计算工具，在神经发育障碍的客观生物标志物开发方面具有潜在应用。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种新颖的计算框架，利用字符串学（研究字符串处理的有效算法）的方法分析脑电图（EEG）时间序列，以系统地识别和表征神经信号中重复出现的时间模式。主要目的是引入定量措施来理解神经信号动力学，目前的研究结果作为概念验证。该框架改编了保序匹配（OPM）和笛卡尔树匹配（CTM）来检测保留相对顺序和分层结构，同时对幅度缩放保持不变的时间基序。这种方法提供了EEG动力学的时间精确表示，补充了传统的频谱和全局复杂性分析。为了评估其实用性，我们将该框架应用于注意力缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）个体和匹配对照组的多通道EEG记录，使用了公开可用数据集。使用OPM和CTM提取并量化了高度重复的、组特异性基序。ADHD组表现出显著更高的基序频率，表明神经活动重复性增加。OPM分析揭示了ADHD患者的基序长度更短，梯度不稳定性更大，这反映在更大的平均和最大样本间幅度变化。CTM分析进一步表明ADHD患者的分层复杂性降低，其特征是树结构更浅，分层级别更少，尽管基序长度相当。这些发现表明，ADHD相关的EEG改变涉及复发时间模式的结构、稳定性以及分层组织方面的系统性差异。所提出的基于字符串学的基序框架提供了一种互补的计算工具，在神经发育障碍的客观生物标志物开发方面具有潜在应用。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种基于字符串学的新型计算框架，用于分析脑电（EEG）信号并识别重复的时间模式。该框架采用保序匹配（OPM）和笛卡尔树匹配（CTM）来检测对幅度缩放不变且保留相对顺序和分层结构的基序。通过对ADHD患者和对照组的EEG数据进行案例研究，发现ADHD组的基序频率显著更高，OPM分析显示其基序更短且梯度不稳定性更大，而CTM分析则揭示了ADHD患者分层复杂性降低。这些结果表明ADHD患者的EEG模式在结构、稳定性和分层组织上存在系统性差异，该框架有望成为神经发育障碍客观生物标志物开发的工具。

AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将字符串学方法引入EEG信号分析，提供了一种新颖且时间精确的神经信号动态表示方法。它通过OPM和CTM技术，能够发现传统方法难以捕捉的、与幅度无关的相对顺序和分层结构。这项工作的重要性在于其对ADHD神经机制提供了新的见解，并为开发神经发育障碍的客观生物标志物提供了潜在工具。

title: Quantifying Ranking Instability Across Evaluation Protocol Axes in Gene Regulatory Network Benchmarking
summary: Benchmark rankings are routinely used to justify scientific claims about method quality in gene regulatory network (GRN) inference, yet the stability of these rankings under plausible evaluation protocol choices is rarely examined. We present a systematic diagnostic framework for measuring ranking instability under protocol shift, including decomposition tools that separate base rate effects from discrimination effects. Using existing single cell GRN benchmark outputs across three human tissues and six inference methods, we quantify pairwise reversal rates across four protocol axes: candidate set restriction (16.3 percent, 95 percent CI 11.0 to 23.4 percent), tissue context (19.3 percent), reference network choice (32.1 percent), and symbol mapping policy (0.0 percent). A permutation null confirms that observed reversal rates are far below random order expectations (0.163 versus null mean 0.500), indicating partially stable but non invariant ranking structure. Our decomposition reveals that reversals are driven by changes in the relative discrimination ability of methods rather than by base rate inflation, a finding that challenges a common implicit assumption in GRN benchmarking. We propose concrete reporting practices for stability aware evaluation and provide a diagnostic toolkit for identifying method pairs at risk of reversal.

AI.title_translation: 基因调控网络基准测试中评估协议轴上的排名不稳定性量化
AI.tldr: 基因调控网络推断方法的基准排名在不同评估协议下不稳定，本文提出了一个诊断框架和报告实践来解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 基因调控网络（GRN）推断中，基准排名常用于证明方法质量，但这些排名在不同评估协议选择下的稳定性却很少被检验。
AI.method: 提出了一个系统的诊断框架，用于衡量协议变化下的排名不稳定性，包括分解工具以分离基准效应和判别效应。使用现有单细胞GRN基准输出，跨越三种人体组织和六种推断方法，量化了四个协议轴上的成对逆转率。
AI.result: 观察到的逆转率远低于随机顺序预期（0.163 对比零假设平均值0.500），表明排名结构部分稳定但并非不变。逆转是由方法相对判别能力的变化而非基准率膨胀驱动的。具体逆转率：候选集限制（16.3%）、组织背景（19.3%）、参考网络选择（32.1%）、符号映射策略（0.0%）。
AI.conclusion: 基因调控网络推断方法的基准排名在不同评估协议下不稳定，这种不稳定性主要由方法的判别能力变化引起。本文提出了稳定性感知评估的具体报告实践和识别有逆转风险方法对的诊断工具包。

title: Controllable Generative Sandbox for Causal Inference
comments: 34 pages, 15 figures. Submitted to ICML 2026. Code available at https://github.com/zhangqiecho/causalmix
summary: Method validation and study design in causal inference rely on synthetic data with known counterfactuals. Existing simulators trade off distributional realism, the ability to capture mixed-type and multimodal tabular data, against causal controllability, including explicit control over overlap, unmeasured confounding, and treatment effect heterogeneity. We introduce CausalMix, a variational generative framework that closes this gap by coupling a mixture of Gaussian latent priors with data-type-specific decoders for continuous, binary, and categorical variables. The model incorporates explicit causal controls: an overlap regularizer shaping propensity-score distributions, alongside direct parameterizations of confounding strength and effect heterogeneity. This unified objective preserves fidelity to the observed data while enabling factorial manipulation of causal mechanisms, allowing overlap, confounding strength, and treatment effect heterogeneity to be varied independently at design time. Across benchmarks, CausalMix achieves state-of-the-art distributional metrics on mixed-type tables while providing stable, fine-grained causal control. We demonstrate practical utility in a comparative safety study of metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer treatments, using CausalMix to compare estimators under calibrated data-generating processes, tune hyperparameters, and conduct simulation-based power analyses under targeted treatment effect heterogeneity scenarios.

AI.title_translation: 可控的因果推断生成沙盒
AI.tldr: CausalMix是一个变分生成框架，旨在弥合现有因果推断模拟器在数据真实性与因果可控性之间的差距，它能生成具有已知反事实的合成数据，并对重叠、未测量混淆和治疗效果异质性提供精细控制。
AI.motivation: 现有因果推断模拟器在分布真实性（捕获混合类型和多模态表格数据）与因果可控性（显式控制重叠、未测量混淆和治疗效果异质性）之间存在权衡，无法同时满足两者需求。
AI.method: 论文提出了CausalMix，一个变分生成框架。它通过将高斯潜在先验的混合与针对连续、二元和分类变量的数据类型特定解码器相结合。该模型包含了显式的因果控制：一个用于塑造倾向得分分布的重叠正则化器，以及对混淆强度和效应异质性的直接参数化。
AI.result: CausalMix在混合类型表格上实现了最先进的分布指标，同时提供了稳定、细粒度的因果控制。它在转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌治疗的比较安全性研究中，成功用于比较估计器、调整超参数和进行基于模拟的功效分析，展示了实用性。
AI.conclusion: CausalMix通过统一目标在保留对观测数据保真度的同时，实现了对因果机制的因子分解操作，允许在设计时独立改变重叠、混淆强度和治疗效果异质性，从而弥合了现有模拟器在分布真实性和因果可控性之间的差距。
AI.translation: 因果推断中的方法验证和研究设计依赖于具有已知反事实的合成数据。现有模拟器在分布真实性（捕获混合类型和多模态表格数据的能力）与因果可控性（包括对重叠、未测量混淆和治疗效果异质性的显式控制）之间进行权衡。我们引入了CausalMix，一个变分生成框架，通过将高斯潜在先验的混合与针对连续、二元和分类变量的数据类型特定解码器相结合来弥合这一差距。该模型包含了显式的因果控制：一个用于塑造倾向得分分布的重叠正则化器，以及对混淆强度和效应异质性的直接参数化。这个统一的目标在保持对观测数据保真度的同时，实现了对因果机制的因子分解操作，允许在设计时独立改变重叠、混淆强度和治疗效果异质性。在各项基准测试中，CausalMix在混合类型表格上实现了最先进的分布指标，同时提供了稳定、细粒度的因果控制。我们在转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌治疗的比较安全性研究中展示了其实用性，使用CausalMix在校准的数据生成过程中比较估计器、调整超参数，并在目标治疗效果异质性情景下进行基于模拟的功效分析。
AI.summary: 论文介绍CausalMix，一个变分生成框架，旨在解决因果推断中合成数据生成器在数据真实性和因果可控性之间的权衡。CausalMix通过结合混合高斯潜在先验和数据类型特定解码器，并集成显式因果控制（如重叠正则化、混淆强度和效应异质性参数化），实现了对混合类型表格数据的最先进分布建模和精细的因果机制控制。该框架能够独立操纵因果变量，并在实际案例中验证了其在估计器比较和功效分析方面的实用性。

AI.comments: 这篇论文提出了一种创新的方法来生成用于因果推断的合成数据，解决了现有模拟器在数据真实性和因果可控性之间的核心矛盾。CausalMix的亮点在于其统一的变分生成框架，能够同时处理混合类型数据并提供对关键因果机制（如重叠、混淆和治疗效果异质性）的精细、独立的控制。这对于因果推断方法验证和研究设计具有重要意义，尤其是在医疗等复杂领域，能够帮助研究人员更准确地评估估计器性能和进行敏感性分析。

title: Empirical Evaluation of No Free Lunch Violations in Permutation-Based Optimization
summary: The No Free Lunch (NFL) theorem guarantees equal average performance only under uniform sampling of a function space closed under permutation (c.u.p.). We ask when this averaging ceases to reflect what benchmarking actually reports. We study an iterative-search setting with sampling without replacement, where algorithms differ only in evaluation order. Binary objectives allow exhaustive evaluation in the fully enumerable case, and efficiency is defined by the first time the global minimum is reached. We then construct two additional benchmarks by algebraically recombining the same baseline functions through sums and differences. Function-algorithm relations are examined via correlation structure, hierarchical clustering, delta heatmaps, and PCA. A one-way ANOVA with Tukey contrasts confirms that algebraic reformulations induce statistically meaningful shifts in performance patterns. The uniformly sampled baseline remains consistent with the global NFL symmetry. In contrast, the algebraically modified benchmarks yield stable re-rankings and coherent clusters of functions and sampling policies. Composite objectives can also exhibit non-additive search effort despite being built from simpler components. Monte Carlo experiments indicate that order effects persist in larger spaces and depend on function class. Taken together, the results show how objective reformulation and benchmark design can generate structured local departures from NFL intuition. They motivate algorithm choice that is aware of both the problem class and the objective representation. This message applies to evolutionary computation as well as to statistical procedures based on relabeling, resampling, and permutation tests.

AI.title_translation: 基于置换优化的无免费午餐定理违规的实证评估
AI.tldr: 研究发现，在迭代搜索和特定的基准设计下，无免费午餐定理（NFL）的平均性能保证不再成立，目标函数重构和基准设计会导致算法性能的稳定重新排序和特定模式，这对于算法选择很重要。
AI.motivation: 该研究旨在探讨无免费午餐（NFL）定理在何种情况下不再能反映基准测试的实际报告结果，即在特定迭代搜索设置中，NFL定理的平均性能保证何时失效。
AI.method: 研究在一个不允许重复采样的迭代搜索环境中进行，算法仅在评估顺序上有所不同。使用二元目标函数进行穷举评估，效率定义为首次达到全局最小值的时间。通过对相同基线函数进行代数重组（求和与求差）构建了两个额外的基准。通过相关结构、层次聚类、Delta热图和PCA分析函数-算法关系。使用单向ANOVA和Tukey对比检验确认性能模式的变化。还进行了蒙特卡洛实验以研究在大空间中的顺序效应。
AI.result: 代数重构导致性能模式发生统计学上显著的变化。均匀采样的基线与全局NFL对称性保持一致。相比之下，代数修改的基准产生了稳定的重新排序以及函数和采样策略的连贯聚类。复合目标函数即使由简单组件构成，也可能表现出非加性搜索努力。蒙特卡洛实验表明，顺序效应在大空间中持续存在并取决于函数类别。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，目标函数重构和基准设计可以导致局部偏离NFL直觉的结构化模式。这激励了在算法选择时需要同时考虑问题类别和目标表示。
AI.translation: 无免费午餐（NFL）定理仅在函数空间在置换下封闭（c.u.p.）且均匀采样的情况下保证平均性能相等。我们探讨了这种平均何时不再反映基准测试实际报告的结果。我们研究了一种不允许重复采样的迭代搜索设置，其中算法仅在评估顺序上有所不同。二元目标函数允许在完全可枚举的情况下进行穷举评估，效率定义为首次达到全局最小值的时间。然后，我们通过对相同的基线函数进行代数重组（求和与求差）构建了两个额外的基准。通过相关结构、层次聚类、Delta热图和PCA检查了函数-算法关系。一项带有Tukey对比的单向ANOVA证实，代数重构导致性能模式发生统计学上显著的变化。均匀采样的基线与全局NFL对称性保持一致。相比之下，代数修改的基准产生了稳定的重新排序以及函数和采样策略的连贯聚类。复合目标函数即使由简单组件构成，也可能表现出非加性搜索努力。蒙特卡洛实验表明，顺序效应在大空间中持续存在并取决于函数类别。总而言之，结果表明目标函数重构和基准设计如何能够产生偏离NFL直觉的结构化局部模式。它们激励了在算法选择时需要同时考虑问题类别和目标表示。这一信息适用于进化计算以及基于重新标记、重新采样和置换测试的统计程序。
AI.summary: 本研究通过实证评估，探讨了在迭代搜索和特定基准设计下，无免费午餐（NFL）定理的平均性能保证不再成立的情况。研究发现，通过代数重构目标函数可以导致算法性能的统计学上显著变化和稳定重新排序，形成连贯的函数和采样策略聚类。结果表明，目标函数的重构和基准设计会产生偏离NFL直觉的结构化模式，强调了在选择算法时需考虑问题类别和目标表示的重要性。
AI.keywords: 无免费午餐定理, 置换优化, 基准测试, 目标函数重构, 算法选择
AI.comments: 该论文通过实证研究挑战了无免费午餐定理在实际基准测试中的普适性，特别是在迭代搜索和目标函数重构的背景下。其创新之处在于通过代数组合和多种分析方法，揭示了目标函数表示对算法性能的深远影响，为优化算法的设计和选择提供了新的视角，强调了上下文相关性而非普适性。

title: Riemannian Langevin Dynamics: Strong Convergence of Geometric Euler-Maruyama Scheme
summary: Low-dimensional structure in real-world data plays an important role in the success of generative models, which motivates diffusion models defined on intrinsic data manifolds. Such models are driven by stochastic differential equations (SDEs) on manifolds, which raises the need for convergence theory of numerical schemes for manifold-valued SDEs. In Euclidean space, the Euler--Maruyama (EM) scheme achieves strong convergence with order $1/2$, but an analogous result for manifold discretizations is less understood in general settings. In this work, we study a geometric version of the EM scheme for SDEs on Riemannian manifolds and prove strong convergence with order $1/2$ under geometric and regularity conditions. As an application, we obtain a Wasserstein bound for sampling on manifolds via the geometric EM discretization of Riemannian Langevin dynamics.

AI.title_translation: 黎曼朗之万动力学：几何欧拉-丸山格式的强收敛性
AI.tldr: 本研究证明了黎曼流形上随机微分方程的几何欧拉-丸山格式在几何和正则条件下具有1/2阶的强收敛性，并将其应用于流形上的采样。
AI.motivation: 真实世界数据中的低维结构对生成模型的成功至关重要，这促使人们在内在数据流形上定义扩散模型。这些模型由流形上的随机微分方程（SDE）驱动，因此需要流形值SDE数值格式的收敛性理论。
AI.method: 本文研究了黎曼流形上SDE的几何欧拉-丸山（EM）格式，并在几何和正则条件下证明了其强收敛性。
AI.result: 我们证明了几何欧拉-丸山格式在几何和正则条件下具有1/2阶的强收敛性。作为一项应用，我们通过黎曼朗之万动力学的几何EM离散化，获得了流形上采样的Wasserstein界。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为黎曼流形上SDE的几何欧拉-丸山格式提供了强收敛性理论，并展示了其在流形上采样应用中的有效性。
AI.translation: 真实世界数据中的低维结构在生成模型的成功中扮演着重要角色，这激发了在内在数据流形上定义扩散模型。这些模型由流形上的随机微分方程（SDEs）驱动，从而提出了对流形值SDE数值格式收敛性理论的需求。在欧几里得空间中，欧拉-丸山（EM）格式实现了1/2阶的强收敛，但在一般设置下，流形离散化的类似结果尚不明确。在这项工作中，我们研究了黎曼流形上SDE的几何版本EM格式，并在几何和正则条件下证明了1/2阶的强收敛性。作为一项应用，我们通过黎曼朗之万动力学的几何EM离散化，获得了流形上采样的Wasserstein界。
AI.summary: 本论文研究了黎曼流形上随机微分方程（SDEs）的几何欧拉-丸山（EM）格式。在几何和正则条件下，作者证明了该几何EM格式具有1/2阶的强收敛性，解决了流形上SDE数值格式收敛性理论的难题。此外，研究还将此结果应用于黎曼朗之万动力学的几何EM离散化，成功获得了流形上采样的Wasserstein界。
AI.keywords: 黎曼朗之万动力学, 几何欧拉-丸山格式, 强收敛性, 随机微分方程, 流形采样
AI.comments: 该论文在流形上的随机微分方程数值分析领域取得了重要进展，特别是为几何欧拉-丸山格式提供了强收敛性证明。这对于基于流形的生成模型和采样方法具有重要的理论和实际意义。其创新之处在于将欧几里得空间的EM格式强收敛性结果推广到更复杂的黎曼流形设置。

title: The Evolution of Eco-routing under Population Growth: Evidence from Six U.S. Cities
summary: Rapid urban population growth drives car travel demand, increasing transport carbon emissions and posing a critical challenge to sustainable development. Although existing studies have demonstrated that eco-routing can reduce individual emissions, research gaps remain. On the one hand, such personal reductions have a negligible impact on overall emissions, and cannot be simply aggregated to capture the complex effects of large-scale eco-routing. On the other hand, under population growth, the long-term effectiveness of eco-routing, as well as the evolution of its efficiency and traveler route choice, remain underexplored. To address these limitations, this study proposes Time-Only and Time-Carbon user equilibrium (UE) models, integrates them with a demand forecasting method for simulating future network traffic, and designs multi-dimensional metrics to characterize urban dynamics. Using real-world road networks, commuting origin-destination (OD) demand, and population projections under various shared socioeconomic pathways (SSPs) for six representative U.S. cities as a case study, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of urban dynamics across different routing strategies and population sizes. The results reveal that while eco-routing mitigates total emissions, emissions in most cities scale superlinearly with population, a scaling order that remains invariant regardless of routing and construction strategies. Moreover, under population growth, travelers using eco-routing tend to increasingly select shorter routes, giving rise to carbon bottlenecks. A strategy of targeted capacity expansion on these critical bottlenecks (0.46% of links) significantly reduces both emissions (3%) and travel time (28%) without compromising eco-routing efficiency. This study provides a foundation for formulating low-carbon urban transport planning and emission reduction policies.

AI.title_translation: 人口增长下生态路径的演变：来自美国六个城市的证据
AI.tldr: 生态路径能缓解总排放，但人口增长下排放仍超线性增长。生态路径使用者倾向选择更短路径导致碳瓶颈。对关键瓶颈进行有针对性的扩容可显著减少排放和旅行时间。
AI.motivation: 快速城市人口增长导致交通碳排放增加，现有生态路径研究忽视了其对整体排放的复杂影响，以及在人口增长下其长期有效性、效率演变和出行者路径选择的未探索方面。
AI.method: 提出了Time-Only和Time-Carbon用户均衡（UE）模型，并将其与需求预测方法相结合以模拟未来网络交通。设计了多维指标来表征城市动态。以美国六个代表性城市的真实路网、通勤OD需求和人口预测作为案例研究。
AI.result: 生态路径能缓解总排放，但在大多数城市中，排放量与人口呈超线性关系，且这种缩放顺序与路径和建设策略无关。在人口增长下，使用生态路径的出行者倾向于越来越多地选择更短的路径，从而产生碳瓶颈。对这些关键瓶颈（占路段的0.46%）进行有针对性的容量扩容，可显著减少排放（3%）和旅行时间（28%），同时不影响生态路径效率。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为制定低碳城市交通规划和减排政策提供了基础。
AI.translation: 快速的城市人口增长推动了汽车出行需求，增加了交通碳排放，对可持续发展构成了严峻挑战。尽管现有研究表明生态路径可以减少个人排放，但研究空白依然存在。一方面，这种个人减排对整体排放的影响微不足道，不能简单地聚合来捕捉大规模生态路径的复杂效应。另一方面，在人口增长下，生态路径的长期有效性，以及其效率和出行者路径选择的演变，仍未得到充分探索。为了解决这些局限性，本研究提出了仅时间（Time-Only）和时间-碳（Time-Carbon）用户均衡（UE）模型，并将其与需求预测方法相结合，用于模拟未来的网络交通，并设计了多维指标来表征城市动态。我们以美国六个代表性城市的真实路网、通勤起点-终点（OD）需求和不同共享社会经济路径（SSPs）下的人口预测作为案例研究，对不同路径策略和人口规模下的城市动态进行了全面分析。结果表明，尽管生态路径可以缓解总排放，但大多数城市的排放量与人口呈超线性关系，这种缩放顺序无论路径和建设策略如何都保持不变。此外，在人口增长下，使用生态路径的出行者倾向于越来越多地选择更短的路径，从而产生碳瓶颈。对这些关键瓶颈（占路段的0.46%）进行有针对性的容量扩容，可以在不损害生态路径效率的情况下显著减少排放（3%）和旅行时间（28%）。本研究为制定低碳城市交通规划和减排政策提供了基础。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决快速城市人口增长下交通碳排放的挑战，以及生态路径在大规模应用和人口增长背景下的局限性。通过提出Time-Only和Time-Carbon用户均衡模型，并结合需求预测方法，研究分析了美国六个城市在不同路径策略和人口规模下的城市动态。研究发现，生态路径虽能缓解总排放，但排放与人口呈超线性关系；人口增长导致生态路径使用者选择更短路径，形成碳瓶颈。针对这些瓶颈进行容量扩容可有效减少排放和旅行时间。
AI.keywords: 生态路径, 人口增长, 交通排放, 用户均衡模型, 碳瓶颈
AI.comments: 这项研究创新性地将生态路径与人口增长动态相结合，并引入了“碳瓶颈”的概念，揭示了大规模生态路径实施可能带来的意想不到的复杂效应。其通过模拟和案例分析，提供了针对性的交通规划和减排政策建议，特别是在瓶颈扩容方面的发现具有重要的实践指导意义。

title: Polyp Segmentation Using Wavelet-Based Cross-Band Integration for Enhanced Boundary Representation
comments: 39th Annual Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems in Europe (EurIPS 2025) Workshop, Copenhagen, Denmark, 2-7 December 2025 MedEurIPS:Medical Imagine Meets EurIPS
summary: Accurate polyp segmentation is essential for early colorectal cancer detection, yet achieving reliable boundary localization remains challenging due to low mucosal contrast, uneven illumination, and color similarity between polyps and surrounding tissue. Conventional methods relying solely on RGB information often struggle to delineate precise boundaries due to weak contrast and ambiguous structures between polyps and surrounding mucosa. To establish a quantitative foundation for this limitation, we analyzed polyp-background contrast in the wavelet domain, revealing that grayscale representations consistently preserve higher boundary contrast than RGB images across all frequency bands. This finding suggests that boundary cues are more distinctly represented in the grayscale domain than in the color domain. Motivated by this finding, we propose a segmentation model that integrates grayscale and RGB representations through complementary frequency-consistent interaction, enhancing boundary precision while preserving structural coherence. Extensive experiments on four benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach achieves superior boundary precision and robustness compared to conventional models.

AI.title_translation: 基于小波域跨频带集成的息肉分割以增强边界表示
AI.tldr: 传统息肉分割受限于低对比度和颜色相似性。研究发现灰度图比RGB图具有更好的边界对比度。因此，提出了一种结合灰度图和RGB信息（通过小波域分析指导的跨频带集成）的分割模型，显著提高了边界分割的精确性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 准确的息肉分割对早期结直肠癌检测至关重要，但由于粘膜对比度低、光照不均和颜色相似性，可靠的边界定位仍然具有挑战性。依赖于RGB信息的传统方法由于对比度弱和结构模糊而难以精确描绘边界。
AI.method: 通过分析息肉-背景对比度在小波域中的表现，发现灰度图在所有频率带上都比RGB图像保留了更高的边界对比度。基于此，提出了一种通过互补的频率一致交互来集成灰度图和RGB表示的分割模型。
AI.result: 实验证明，所提出的方法在四个基准数据集上实现了优于传统模型的边界精度和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法通过集成灰度图和RGB表示，增强了边界精度并保持了结构一致性，在四个基准数据集上取得了优于传统模型的边界精度和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 准确的息肉分割对于早期结直肠癌检测至关重要，然而，由于粘膜对比度低、光照不均以及息肉与周围组织之间的颜色相似性，实现可靠的边界定位仍然具有挑战性。仅依赖RGB信息的传统方法由于边界对比度弱和息肉与周围粘膜之间的结构模糊，在描绘精确边界方面往往很吃力。为了建立这种局限性的定量基础，我们分析了小波域中的息肉-背景对比度，结果显示，在所有频率带上，灰度表示始终比RGB图像保留了更高的边界对比度。这一发现表明，边界线索在灰度域中比在彩色域中表示得更清晰。受这一发现的激励，我们提出了一种通过互补的频率一致交互来集成灰度图和RGB表示的分割模型，从而在保持结构一致性的同时增强了边界精度。在四个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，与传统模型相比，所提出的方法实现了卓越的边界精度和鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 为解决息肉分割中因对比度低和结构模糊导致的边界定位难题，本文基于小波域分析发现灰度图比RGB图更能保留边界对比度。受此启发，提出了一种通过互补频率一致交互集成灰度图和RGB表示的分割模型，以增强边界表示的精确性。实验验证了该方法的优越性。
AI.keywords: 息肉分割, 小波变换, 边界表示, 灰度图, 跨频带集成
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于利用小波变换分析了灰度图和RGB图在不同频带下的边界对比度差异，并基于“灰度图保留更高边界对比度”的发现，提出了一种结合灰度图和RGB信息的跨频带集成方法，以增强边界表示。其重要性在于提高了结直肠息肉分割的边界精度。局限性未在摘要中明确提及。

title: Mathematicians in the age of AI
summary: Recent developments show that AI can prove research-level theorems in mathematics, both formally and informally. This essay urges mathematicians to stay up-to-date with the technology, to consider the ways it will disrupt mathematical practice, and to respond appropriately to the challenges and opportunities we now face.

AI.tldr: AI已经能证明复杂的数学定理了，数学家们必须立刻跟上这波技术浪潮，否则将被淘汰。

AI.method: 这是一篇论述性的“随笔”（essay），旨在呼吁和探讨，而非提出具体的技术方法或实验。

title: Frequency Security-Aware Production Scheduling of Utility-Scale Off-Grid Renewable P2H Systems Coordinating Heterogeneous Electrolyzers
summary: Renewable power-to-hydrogen (ReP2H) enables large-scale renewable energy utilization and supports the decarbonization of hard-to-abate sectors, such as chemicals and maritime transport, via hydrogen-based renewable ammonia and methanol fuels. As a result, utility-scale ReP2H projects are expanding worldwide. However, off-grid ReP2H systems exhibit low inertia due to their converter-dominated nature, making frequency security a critical concern. Although recent studies show that electrolyzers can contribute to frequency regulation (FR), their support capability depends on operating states and loading levels, creating a trade-off between hydrogen output and frequency security. To address this challenge, this work develops a unified co-optimization framework for frequency security-aware production scheduling of utility-scale off-grid ReP2H systems coordinating heterogeneous electrolyzers. A system-level frequency response model is established to capture multi-stage FR from alkaline water electrolyzers (AWEs), proton exchange membrane electrolyzers (PEMELs), and other resources, including ammonia-fueled generators retrofitted in co-located chemical plants, battery energy storage, and wind turbines (WTs). Stage-wise transient frequency security constraints are derived, reformulated into tractable forms, and embedded into production scheduling, enabling coordinated on/off switching and load allocation across electrolyzers to maximize hydrogen output under uncertain renewable power input while enforcing frequency security constraints. Case studies based on real-world systems demonstrate that the proposed approach allows HPs to replace 55.52% and 96.85% of FR reserves from WTs and AFGs, respectively, while maintaining comparable hydrogen output. Year-long simulations show an average 28.96% increase in annual net profit resulting from reduced reliance on conventional reserves.

AI.title_translation: 协调异构电解槽的公用事业规模离网可再生能源制氢系统的频率安全感知生产调度
AI.tldr: 为解决离网可再生能源制氢系统（ReP2H）因惯量低导致的频率安全问题，本文提出了一种将频率安全约束纳入生产调度的协同优化框架，该框架协调不同类型的电解槽，以在最大化氢气产出的同时保障电网频率稳定，并通过案例证明了其能显著减少对传统调频备用的需求并提高利润。
AI.motivation: 并网型可再生能源制氢（ReP2H）系统正快速发展，但离网系统因其以换流器为主的特性导致惯量低，频率安全成为关键问题。电解槽虽然能提供频率支撑，但其能力受运行状态和负载水平限制，与氢气产出存在权衡。因此，需要开发一种方法来解决这一挑战。
AI.method: 建立系统级频率响应模型，捕获碱性水电解槽（AWEs）、质子交换膜电解槽（PEMELs）及其他资源（氨燃料发电机、储能、风力发电机）的多阶段频率调节能力。推导出分阶段的瞬态频率安全约束，并将其重构为可处理的形式，嵌入到生产调度中，以协同控制电解槽的启停和负载分配。
AI.result: 所提出的方法使氢站（HPs）能够替代风力发电机（WTs）55.52%和氨燃料发电机（AFGs）96.85%的频率调节备用，同时保持可比的氢气产出。年度模拟显示，由于对传统备用的依赖减少，年平均净利润提高了28.96%。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法能够通过协调异构电解槽的运行，在最大化氢气产出的同时，有效满足频率安全约束，显著减少对传统调频备用的依赖，并带来更高的年净利润。
AI.translation: 可再生能源制氢（ReP2H）技术使大规模可再生能源的利用和对化工、海运等难以减排行业的脱碳支持成为可能，这依赖于氢基可再生氨和甲醇燃料。因此，全球范围内公用事业规模的ReP2H项目正在扩张。然而，离网ReP2H系统由于其以换流器为主的特性而表现出低惯量，使频率安全成为一个关键问题。尽管最近的研究表明电解槽可以为频率调节（FR）做出贡献，但其支撑能力取决于运行状态和负载水平，在氢气输出和频率安全之间形成了权衡。为应对这一挑战，本工作开发了一个统一的协同优化框架，用于协调异构电解槽的公用事业规模离网ReP2H系统的频率安全感知生产调度。建立了一个系统级频率响应模型，以捕获碱性水电解槽（AWEs）、质子交换膜电解槽（PEMELs）以及其他资源（包括在共址化工厂中改装的氨燃料发电机、电池储能和风力发电机（WTs））的多阶段FR。推导了分阶段的瞬态频率安全约束，将其重构为可处理的形式，并嵌入到生产调度中，从而能够协调电解槽的启停和负载分配，以在不确定可再生能源输入下最大化氢气产出，同时强制执行频率安全约束。基于真实世界系统的案例研究表明，所提出的方法允许氢站（HPs）分别替代WTs和AFGs 55.52%和96.85%的FR备用，同时保持可比的氢气产出。年度模拟显示，由于对传统备用的依赖减少，年平均净利润提高了28.96%。
AI.summary: 本研究针对离网型公用事业规模可再生能源制氢（ReP2H）系统固有的低惯量和频率安全挑战，提出了一种统一的协同优化框架。该框架通过建立包含异构电解槽（AWEs、PEMELs）及其他资源的系统级频率响应模型，将瞬态频率安全约束嵌入到生产调度中，以在不确定可再生能源输入下最大化氢气产出，同时确保频率安全。案例研究验证了该方法在替代调频备用和提高经济效益方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 可再生能源制氢, 频率安全, 生产调度, 异构电解槽, 离网系统
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个统一的协同优化框架，用于协调异构电解槽，同时考虑频率安全性和氢气产出，解决了并网型可再生能源制氢系统（ReP2H）在离网运行时惯量低、频率安全面临挑战的问题。通过将分阶段的瞬态频率安全约束纳入生产调度，实现了电解槽的协同开关和负载分配，以在不牺牲氢气产出的前提下保障电网频率安全。结果显示，该方法能显著替代传统调频备用，并提高年净利润。限制是研究基于特定系统（AWEs, PEMELs, 氨燃料发电机, BESS, WTs）的案例，其普适性有待进一步验证。

title: Generalization Properties of Score-matching Diffusion Models for Intrinsically Low-dimensional Data
summary: Despite the remarkable empirical success of score-based diffusion models, their statistical guarantees remain underdeveloped. Existing analyses often provide pessimistic convergence rates that do not reflect the intrinsic low-dimensional structure common in real data, such as that arising in natural images. In this work, we study the statistical convergence of score-based diffusion models for learning an unknown distribution $μ$ from finitely many samples. Under mild regularity conditions on the forward diffusion process and the data distribution, we derive finite-sample error bounds on the learned generative distribution, measured in the Wasserstein-$p$ distance. Unlike prior results, our guarantees hold for all $p \ge 1$ and require only a finite-moment assumption on $μ$, without compact-support, manifold, or smooth-density conditions. Specifically, given $n$ i.i.d.\ samples from $μ$ with finite $q$-th moment and appropriately chosen network architectures, hyperparameters, and discretization schemes, we show that the expected Wasserstein-$p$ error between the learned distribution $\hatμ$ and $μ$ scales as $\mathbb{E}\, \mathbb{W}_p(\hatμ,μ) = \widetilde{O}\!\left(n^{-1 / d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)}\right),$ where $d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)$ is the $(p,q)$-Wasserstein dimension of $μ$. Our results demonstrate that diffusion models naturally adapt to the intrinsic geometry of data and mitigate the curse of dimensionality, since the convergence rate depends on $d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)$ rather than the ambient dimension. Moreover, our theory conceptually bridges the analysis of diffusion models with that of GANs and the sharp minimax rates established in optimal transport. The proposed $(p,q)$-Wasserstein dimension also extends classical Wasserstein dimension notions to distributions with unbounded support, which may be of independent theoretical interest.

AI.title_translation: 分数匹配扩散模型在内在低维数据上的泛化性质
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了分数匹配扩散模型在学习内在低维数据分布方面的理论分析，推导了有限样本误差界限，并表明其收敛率取决于数据的内在维度而非环境维度。
AI.motivation: 现有分数匹配扩散模型在统计保证方面存在不足，特别是对于具有内在低维结构的数据（如自然图像），其收敛率分析通常过于悲观，未能反映数据的内在几何特性。
AI.method: 研究了分数匹配扩散模型学习未知分布μ的统计收敛性，在温和的正则性条件下，推导了学习到的生成分布的有限样本误差界限，并使用Wasserstein-p距离进行衡量。
AI.result: 在有限的q阶矩假设下，证明了学习到的分布与真实分布之间的期望Wasserstein-p距离的收敛率与数据的(p,q)-Wasserstein维度d*_{p,q}(μ)有关，而不是环境维度。具体收敛率为\widetilde{O}(n^{-1 / d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)})。
AI.conclusion: 分数匹配扩散模型能够自适应地学习数据的内在几何结构，有效缓解维度灾难问题。该理论分析将扩散模型与GANs和最优传输的分析联系起来，并提出了适用于无界支撑分布的(p,q)-Wasserstein维度。
AI.translation: 尽管基于分数的扩散模型取得了显著的经验成功，但它们的统计保证仍然不完善。现有的分析通常提供悲观的收敛率，未能反映真实数据中常见的内在低维结构，例如自然图像中出现的结构。在本研究中，我们研究了从有限样本中学习未知分布μ的分数匹配扩散模型的统计收敛性。在对前向扩散过程和数据分布的温和正则性条件下，我们推导了学习到的生成分布的有限样本误差界限，用Wasserstein-p距离来衡量。与先前的结果不同，我们的保证适用于所有 $p \ge 1$，并且只需要对μ进行有限矩假设，而无需紧支撑、流形或光滑密度条件。具体来说，给定来自μ的n个独立同分布样本，具有有限的q阶矩和适当选择的网络架构、超参数和离散化方案，我们证明了学习到的分布 $\hatμ$ 和μ之间的期望Wasserstein-p误差尺度为 $\mathbb{E}\, \mathbb{W}_p(\hatμ,μ) = \widetilde{O}(n^{-1 / d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)})$, 其中 $d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)$ 是μ的 $(p,q)$-Wasserstein维度。我们的结果表明，扩散模型能够自然地适应数据的内在几何结构，并缓解维度灾难，因为收敛率取决于 $d^\ast_{p,q}(μ)$ 而不是环境维度。此外，我们的理论在概念上将扩散模型的分析与GANs的分析以及最优传输中确定的精确minimax率联系起来。所提出的 $(p,q)$-Wasserstein维度也将经典的Wasserstein维度概念扩展到具有无界支撑的分布，这可能具有独立的理论意义。
AI.summary: 本研究为分数匹配扩散模型在学习内在低维数据分布方面提供了理论分析。论文推导了有限样本误差界限，表明模型的收敛率仅取决于数据的内在(p,q)-Wasserstein维度，而非环境维度，从而有效缓解了维度灾难。该理论还连接了扩散模型、GANs和最优传输的分析。
AI.keywords: 分数匹配扩散模型, 泛化性质, 内在低维数据, Wasserstein维度, 维度灾难
AI.comments: 这项工作在理论上为分数匹配扩散模型在处理具有内在低维结构的数据集时提供了重要的见解。通过推导依赖于数据的内在几何特征（(p,q)-Wasserstein维度）的收敛率，该研究有效地解决了现有模型在实际应用中可能遇到的维度灾难问题。此外，将扩散模型的分析与GANs和最优传输的理论联系起来，为该领域的研究提供了新的视角和潜在的协同效应。然而，实际网络架构、超参数和离散化方案的选择对理论保证的实现至关重要，这可能是在实际应用中需要进一步探索的方面。

title: Observationally Informed Adaptive Causal Experimental Design
summary: Randomized Controlled Trials (RCTs) represent the gold standard for causal inference yet remain a scarce resource. While large-scale observational data is often available, it is utilized only for retrospective fusion, and remains discarded in prospective trial design due to bias concerns. We argue this "tabula rasa" data acquisition strategy is fundamentally inefficient. In this work, we propose Active Residual Learning, a new paradigm that leverages the observational model as a foundational prior. This approach shifts the experimental focus from learning target causal quantities from scratch to efficiently estimating the residuals required to correct observational bias. To operationalize this, we introduce the R-Design framework. Theoretically, we establish two key advantages: (1) a structural efficiency gap, proving that estimating smooth residual contrasts admits strictly faster convergence rates than reconstructing full outcomes; and (2) information efficiency, where we quantify the redundancy in standard parameter-based acquisition (e.g., BALD), demonstrating that such baselines waste budget on task-irrelevant nuisance uncertainty. We propose R-EPIG (Residual Expected Predictive Information Gain), a unified criterion that directly targets the causal estimand, minimizing residual uncertainty for estimation or clarifying decision boundaries for policy. Experiments on synthetic and semi-synthetic benchmarks demonstrate that R-Design significantly outperforms baselines, confirming that repairing a biased model is far more efficient than learning one from scratch.

AI.title_translation: 观测知情自适应因果实验设计
AI.tldr: 与其完全抛弃有偏的观测数据，不如用它作为起点来设计更高效的因果实验。我们提出R-Design，通过学习“残差”来修正观测偏差，这比从零开始学习因果关系要快得多，并且能更智能地分配实验预算。
AI.motivation: 随机对照试验（RCTs）资源稀缺，而大规模观测数据常被因果推断设计所忽略，仅用于回顾性融合，这种“白板”数据获取策略效率低下。目标是更有效地利用现有观测数据来指导前瞻性试验设计。
AI.method: 提出主动残差学习（Active Residual Learning）范式，将观测模型作为基础先验。在此基础上，引入R-Design框架来操作化这一方法，并提出了一个统一的准则R-EPIG（残差期望预测信息增益）来直接针对因果估计量。
AI.result: 理论上证明了估计平滑残差对比具有更快的收敛速度（结构效率差距），并量化了标准参数化采集方法（如BALD）在任务不相关的噪声不确定性上的预算浪费（信息效率）。实验表明R-Design显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，R-Design显著优于基线方法，证实了修复有偏模型比从头学习模型效率高得多。
AI.translation: 随机对照试验（RCTs）是因果推断的黄金标准，但仍然稀缺。虽然通常可以获得大规模观测数据，但由于存在偏差问题，它仅被用于回顾性融合，并在前瞻性试验设计中被丢弃。我们认为这种“白板”数据获取策略在根本上是低效的。在这项工作中，我们提出了主动残差学习（Active Residual Learning），一种新的范式，它利用观测模型作为基础先验。这种方法将实验重点从从头学习目标因果量转移到有效估计校正观测偏差所需的残差上。为了实现这一点，我们引入了R-Design框架。在理论上，我们确立了两个关键优势：（1）结构效率差距，证明估计平滑残差对比具有比重建完整结果严格更快的收敛速度；（2）信息效率，我们量化了标准基于参数的采集（例如BALD）中的冗余，证明此类基线在与任务无关的噪声不确定性上浪费了预算。我们提出了R-EPIG（残差期望预测信息增益），一个直接针对因果估计量的统一标准，用于最小化估计残差或阐明决策边界。在合成和半合成基准上的实验表明，R-Design显著优于基线方法，证实了修复有偏模型比从头学习模型效率高得多。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“观测知情自适应因果实验设计”的新范式——主动残差学习（Active Residual Learning），旨在克服传统因果推断依赖稀缺RCTs的局限性，并通过将现有观测数据用作基础先验，将实验重点转移到高效估计校正观测偏差所需的残差上。R-Design框架通过理论证明了估计残差比重建完整结果更有效率，并通过R-EPIG准则指导实验，实验结果验证了该方法比从头学习模型更高效。
AI.keywords: 因果推断, 随机对照试验, 观测数据, 主动学习, 残差学习
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了主动残差学习（Active Residual Learning）范式，将观测数据用作先验，而不是像传统方法那样被抛弃。它在理论上证明了估计残差对比的收敛速度比重建完整结果更快，并且在信息效率上指出了标准基于参数的采集方法（如BALD）的浪费。R-Design框架的提出及其在合成和半合成基准上的优越性能，有力地支持了“修复有偏模型比从头学习更有效”的论点。然而，其在高度复杂的真实世界（非合成）场景下的鲁棒性和可扩展性有待进一步验证。

title: Non-Invasive Reconstruction of Cardiac Activation Dynamics Using Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary:
Cardiac arrhythmogenesis is governed by complex electromechanical interactions that are not directly observable in vivo, motivating the development of non-invasive computational approaches for reconstructing three-dimensional activation dynamics. We present a physics-informed neural network framework for recovering cardiac activation patterns, active tension propagation, deformation fields, and hydrostatic pressure from measurable deformation data in simplified left ventricular geometries. Our approach integrates nonlinear anisotropic constitutive modeling, heterogeneous fiber orientation, weak formulations of the governing mechanics, and finite-element-based loss functions to embed physical constraints directly into training.
  We demonstrate that the proposed framework accurately reconstructs spatiotemporal activation dynamics under varying levels of measurement noise and reduced spatial resolution, while preserving global propagation patterns and activation timing. By coupling mechanistic modeling with data-driven inference, this method establishes a pathway toward patient-specific, non-invasive reconstruction of cardiac activation, with potential applications in digital phenotyping and computational support for arrhythmia assessment.

AI.title_translation: 使用物理信息神经网络进行心脏激活动力学的非侵入式重建
AI.tldr: 研究人员利用物理信息神经网络（PINN）结合力学模型，仅通过测量到的左心室变形数据，就能准确地非侵入式地重建出复杂的心脏激活、张力、变形和压力等动力学信息，即使在数据质量不佳的情况下也能保持准确性。
AI.motivation: 由于体内（in vivo）的电机械相互作用复杂且不可直接观测，因此需要开发非侵入性的计算方法来重建三维激活动力学。
AI.method: 提出了一种物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于从可测量的变形数据中恢复心脏激活模式、主动张力传播、变形场和静水压力。该方法整合了非线性各向异性本构建模、异质纤维取向、控制力学的弱形式以及基于有限元的损失函数，将物理约束直接嵌入到训练过程中。
AI.result: 所提出的框架在不同测量噪声和降低的空间分辨率下，准确地重建了时空激活动力学，同时保留了全局传播模式和激活时间。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过结合机械建模和数据驱动推理，为患者特异性的、非侵入式的心脏激活重建建立了一条途径，在数字表型和心律失常评估的计算支持方面具有潜在应用。
AI.translation: 心脏致心律失常性由复杂的电机械相互作用控制，这些相互作用在体内（in vivo）无法直接观测，这促使了用于重建三维激活动力学的非侵入式计算方法的发展。我们提出了一个物理信息神经网络框架，用于从简化的左心室几何结构的可测量变形数据中恢复心脏激活模式、主动张力传播、变形场和静水压力。我们的方法整合了非线性各向异性本构建模、异质纤维取向、控制力学的弱形式以及基于有限元的损失函数，将物理约束直接嵌入到训练中。我们证明了所提出的框架能够在不同测量噪声和降低的空间分辨率下准确地重建时空激活动力学，同时保留全局传播模式和激活时间。通过将机制建模与数据驱动的推理相结合，该方法为患者特异性的、非侵入式的心脏激活重建建立了一条途径，在数字表型和心律失常评估的计算支持方面具有潜在应用。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息神经网络（PINN）的非侵入式框架，用于从可测量的变形数据中重建心脏的三维激活动力学、张力、变形和压力。该方法通过将非线性本构模型和力学约束嵌入到神经网络训练中，成功地在不同噪声和分辨率下准确地重构了时空激活模式，为患者特异性的心脏评估提供了新的途径。
AI.keywords: 物理信息神经网络, 心肌激活动力学, 非侵入式重建, 左心室, 机械建模
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地将物理信息（如非线性本构模型、纤维取向、力学控制方程的弱形式和基于有限元的损失函数）嵌入到神经网络训练中，以实现心脏激活动力学的非侵入式重建。其重要性在于提供了一种耦合机制模型与数据驱动推理的工具，有望用于患者特异性的心脏评估。摘要中未明确指出局限性。

title: Invariance-Based Dynamic Regret Minimization
summary: We consider stochastic non-stationary linear bandits where the linear parameter connecting contexts to the reward changes over time. Existing algorithms in this setting localize the policy by gradually discarding or down-weighting past data, effectively shrinking the time horizon over which learning can occur. However, in many settings historical data may still carry partial information about the reward model. We propose to leverage such data while adapting to changes, by assuming the reward model decomposes into stationary and non-stationary components. Based on this assumption, we introduce ISD-linUCB, an algorithm that uses past data to learn invariances in the reward model and subsequently exploits them to improve online performance. We show both theoretically and empirically that leveraging invariance reduces the problem dimensionality, yielding significant regret improvements in fast-changing environments when sufficient historical data is available.

title: Fast proton transport and neutron production in proton therapy using Fourier neural operators
comments: 25 pages, 12 figures. When specified, figures can be visualized as video using suitable PDF readers
summary:
Objective: Real-time adaptive proton range verification systems based on produced neutrons require accurate information on their non-isotropic momentum distributions within short times, for which Monte Carlo (MC) methods are too computationally expensive. We present a surrogate model based on Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) for fast prediction of angle- and energy-resolved proton transport and neutron production within proton therapy.
  Approach: We treat the irradiated phantom and the proton beam's state as depth-evolving series, respectively of different materials, and of spatial, angular and energy phase space density distributions. The task is solved auto-regressively by learning changes in the distributions of protons and those of produced neutrons. For training and evaluation, two datasets of 47 MC simulations featuring different primary intensities were produced. Simulated geometries were extracted from a thoracic CT scan as series of laterally homogeneous materials.
  Main Results: An average relative $L^2$ discrepancy of 0.067 and 0.137 was achieved by the predicted proton and neutron distributions, respectively. This corresponded to an average gamma passing rate in the spatial distributions of 99.95$\%$ and 99.40$\%$. Training with higher primary intensities led to improvements between 12$\%$ and 30$\%$ in density metrics. Inference over depths of 40 cm at a resolution of 0.5 mm required on average 23.17 s per beam.
  Significance: The proposed proton beam surrogate generates accurate spatial and momentum distributions of neutrons at MC-level accuracy within seconds, while demonstrating robust generalization with respect to irradiated geometry and beam characteristics. This approach can be used for prototyping and operation of range verification systems, other tasks such as neutron dose estimation, and can be extended to include other kinds of secondary emissions.
comment: 25 pages, 12 figures. When specified, figures can be visualized as video using suitable PDF readers

title: Identification of Nonlinear Acyclic Networks in Continuous Time from Nonzero Initial Conditions and Full Excitations
comments: 12 pages, 5 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Network Science and Engineering
summary: We propose a method to identify nonlinear acyclic networks in continuous time when the dynamics are located on the edges and all the nodes are excited. We show that it is necessary and sufficient to measure all the sinks to identify any tree in continuous time when the functions associated with the dynamics are analytic and satisfy $f(0)=0$, which is analogous to the discrete-time case. For general directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), we show that it is necessary and sufficient to measure all sinks, assuming that the dynamics are not linear (a condition that can be relaxed for trees). Then, based on the measurement of higher order derivatives and nonzero initial conditions, we introduce a method for the identification of trees, which allows us to recover the nonlinear functions located in the edges of the network under the assumption of dictionary functions. Finally, we propose a method to identify multiple parallel paths of the same length between two nodes, which allow us to identify any DAG when combined with the algorithm for the identification of trees. Several examples are added to illustrate the results.
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Network Science and Engineering

title: Spectrally Corrected Polynomial Approximation for Quantum Singular Value Transformation
summary:
Quantum Singular Value Transformation (QSVT) provides a unified framework for applying polynomial functions to the singular values of a block-encoded matrix. QSVT prepares a state proportional to $\bA^{-1}\bb$ with circuit depth $O(d\cdot\mathrm{polylog}(N))$, where $d$ is the polynomial degree of the $1/x$ approximation and $N$ is the size of $\bA$. Current polynomial approximation methods are over the continuous interval $[a,1]$, giving $d = O(\sqrt{\kap}\log(1/\varepsilon))$, and make no use of any properties of $\bA$.
  We observe here that QSVT solution accuracy depends only on the polynomial accuracy at the eigenvalues of $\bA$. When all $N$ eigenvalues are known exactly, a pure spectral polynomial $p_{S}$ can interpolate $1/x$ at these eigenvalues and achieve unit fidelity at reduced degree. But its practical applicability is limited. To address this, we propose a spectral correction that exploits prior knowledge of $K$ eigenvalues of $\bA$. Given any base polynomial $p_0$, such as Remez, of degree $d_0$, a $K\times K$ linear system enforces exact interpolation of $1/x$ only at these $K$ eigenvalues without increasing $d_0$. The spectrally corrected polynomial $p_{SC}$ preserves the continuous error profile between eigenvalues and inherits the parity of $p_0$.
  QSVT experiments on the 1D Poisson equation demonstrate up to a $5\times$ reduction in circuit depth relative to the base polynomial, at unit fidelity and improved compliance error. The correction is agnostic to the choice of base polynomial and robust to eigenvalue perturbations up to $10\%$ relative error. Extension to the 2D Poisson equation suggests that correcting a small fraction of the spectrum may suffice to achieve fidelity above $0.999$.

title: Differential Goppa Codes
summary:
Rosenbloom and Tsfasman, in their foundational work on the $m$-metric, introduced algebraic-geometric codes defined by multiple points on a smooth projective curve $X$. This construction involves a divisor $G$ and another divisor $D=\sum n p_i$, where $p_i$ are distinct rational points with $p_i \notin \text{supp}(G)$ and $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Although these codes are significant, their formal development for arbitrary genus remains incomplete in the literature, as most studies have concentrated on the genus $0$ case.
  We present a rigorous treatment of this class of codes. Starting with a smooth projective curve $X$, an invertible sheaf $L$, and an effective divisor $D=\sum n_i p_i$ where the $n_i$ are not necessarily equal, as well as tuples of uniformizers $t_D$ at the points of $D$ and trivializations $γ_D$ for the localizations $L_{p_i}$, the associated differential Goppa code is defined. This code arises from the theory of $n$-jets of invertible sheaves on curves, which enables the description of codewords using Hasse-Schmidt derivatives of sections of $L$.
  The variation of the code under changes in the data $(t_D, γ_D)$ is examined, and the group acting on these parameters is described. The behavior of the minimum Hamming distance under such variations is analyzed, with explicit examples provided for curves of genus $0$ and $1$. A duality theorem is established, involving principal parts of meromorphic differential forms. It is demonstrated that Goppa codes constitute a proper subclass of differential Goppa codes, and that every linear code admits a differential Goppa code structure on $\mathbb P^1$ using only two rational points.

title: An Adaptive KKT-Based Indicator for Convergence Assessment in Multi-Objective Optimization
summary:
Performance indicators are essential tools for assessing the convergence behavior of multi-objective optimization algorithms, particularly when the true Pareto front is
  unknown or difficult to approximate. Classical reference-based metrics such as
  hypervolume and inverted generational distance are widely used, but may suffer from
  scalability limitations and sensitivity to parameter choices in many-objective scenarios.
  Indicators derived from Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) optimality conditions provide an
  intrinsic alternative by quantifying stationarity without relying on external reference
  sets. This paper revisits an entropy-inspired KKT-based convergence indicator and proposes a
  robust adaptive reformulation based on quantile normalization. The proposed indicator
  preserves the stationarity-based interpretation of the original formulation while
  improving robustness to heterogeneous distributions of stationarity residuals, a
  recurring issue in many-objective optimization.

title: Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements: A framework for quantum hypothesis testing and semidefinite optimization
summary: Quantum measurements are the means by which we recover messages encoded into quantum states. They are at the forefront of quantum hypothesis testing, wherein the goal is to perform an optimal measurement for arriving at a correct conclusion. Mathematically, a measurement operator is Hermitian with eigenvalues in [0,1]. By noticing that this constraint on each eigenvalue is the same as that imposed on fermions by the Pauli exclusion principle, we interpret every eigenmode of a measurement operator as an independent effective fermionic mode. Under this perspective, various objective functions in quantum hypothesis testing can be viewed as the total expected energy associated with these fermionic occupation numbers. By instead fixing a temperature and minimizing the total expected fermionic free energy, we find that optimal measurements for these modified objective functions are Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements, wherein their eigenvalues are specified by Fermi-Dirac distributions. In the low-temperature limit, their performance closely approximates that of optimal measurements for quantum hypothesis testing, and we show that their parameters can be learned by classical or hybrid quantum-classical optimization algorithms. This leads to a new quantum machine-learning model, termed Fermi-Dirac machines, consisting of parameterized Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements-an alternative to quantum Boltzmann machines based on thermal states. Beyond hypothesis testing, we show how general semidefinite optimization problems can be solved using this approach, leading to a novel paradigm for semidefinite optimization on quantum computers, in which the goal is to implement thermal measurements rather than prepare thermal states. Finally, we propose quantum algorithms for implementing Fermi-Dirac thermal measurements, and we also propose second-order hybrid quantum-classical optimization algorithms.

title: End-to-end event reconstruction for precision physics at future colliders
summary: Future collider experiments require unprecedented precision in measurements of Higgs, electroweak, and flavour observables, placing stringent demands on event reconstruction. The achievable precision on Higgs couplings scales directly with the resolution on visible final state particles and their invariant masses. Current particle flow algorithms rely on detector specific clustering, limiting flexibility during detector design. Here we present an end-to-end global event reconstruction approach that maps charged particle tracks and calorimeter and muon hits directly to particle level objects. The method combines geometric algebra transformer networks with object condensation based clustering, followed by dedicated networks for particle identification and energy regression. Our approach is benchmarked on fully simulated electron positron collisions at FCC-ee using the CLD detector concept. It outperforms the state-of-the-art rule-based algorithm by 10--20\% in relative reconstruction efficiency, achieves up to two orders of magnitude reduction in fake-particle rates for charged hadrons, and improves visible energy and invariant mass resolution by 22\%. By decoupling reconstruction performance from detector-specific tuning, this framework enables rapid iteration during the detector design phase of future collider experiments.

title: Lyapunov Stability of Stochastic Vector Optimization: Theory and Numerical Implementation
summary: The use of stochastic differential equations in multi-objective optimization has been limited, in practice, by two persistent gaps: incomplete stability analyses and the absence of accessible implementations. We revisit a drift--diffusion model for unconstrained vector optimization in which the drift is induced by a common descent direction and the diffusion term preserves exploratory behavior. The main theoretical contribution is a self-contained Lyapunov analysis establishing global existence, pathwise uniqueness, and non-explosion under a dissipativity condition, together with positive recurrence under an additional coercivity assumption. We also derive an Euler--Maruyama discretization and implement the resulting iteration as a \emph{pymoo}-compatible algorithm -- \emph{pymoo} being an open-source Python framework for multi-objective optimization -- with an interactive \emph{PymooLab} front-end for reproducible experiments. Empirical results on DTLZ2 with objective counts from three to fifteen indicate a consistent trade-off: compared with established evolutionary baselines, the method is less competitive in low-dimensional regimes but remains a viable option under restricted evaluation budgets in higher-dimensional settings. Taken together, these observations suggest that stochastic drift--diffusion search occupies a mathematically tractable niche alongside population-based heuristics -- not as a replacement, but as an alternative whose favorable properties are amenable to rigorous analysis.

title: Efficient Time-Aware Partitioning of Quantum Circuits for Distributed Quantum Computing
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, conference: accepted at QCNC 2026
summary: To overcome the physical limitations of scaling monolithic quantum computers, distributed quantum computing (DQC) interconnects multiple smaller-scale quantum processing units (QPUs) to form a quantum network. However, this approach introduces a critical challenge, namely the high cost of quantum communication between remote QPUs incurred by quantum state teleportation and quantum gate teleportation. To minimize this communication overhead, DQC compilers must strategically partition quantum circuits by mapping logical qubits to distributed physical QPUs. Static graph partitioning methods are fundamentally ill-equipped for this task as they ignore execution dynamics and underlying network topology, while metaheuristics require substantial computational runtime. In this work, we propose a heuristic based on beam search to solve the circuit partitioning problem. Our time-aware algorithm incrementally constructs a low-cost sequence of qubit assignments across successive time steps to minimize overall communication overhead. The time and space complexities of the proposed algorithm scale quadratically with the number of qubits and linearly with circuit depth, offering a significant computational speedup over common metaheuristics. We demonstrate that our proposed algorithm consistently achieves significantly lower communication costs than static baselines across varying circuit sizes, depths, and network topologies, providing an efficient compilation tool for near-term distributed quantum hardware.

title: Exploiting Subgradient Sparsity in Max-Plus Neural Networks
summary: Deep Neural Networks are powerful tools for solving machine learning problems, but their training often involves dense and costly parameter updates. In this work, we use a novel Max-Plus neural architecture in which classical addition and multiplication are replaced with maximum and summation operations respectively. This is a promising architecture in terms of interpretability, but its training is challenging. A particular feature is that this algebraic structure naturally induces sparsity in the subgradients, as only neurons that contribute to the maximum affect the loss. However, standard backpropagation fails to exploit this sparsity, leading to unnecessary computations. In this work, we focus on the minimization of the worst sample loss which transfers this sparsity to the optimization loss. To address this, we propose a sparse subgradient algorithm that explicitly exploits the algebraic sparsity. By tailoring the optimization procedure to the non-smooth nature of Max-Plus models, our method achieves more efficient updates while retaining theoretical guarantees. This highlights a principled path toward bridging algebraic structure and scalable learning.

title: The Pivotal Information Criterion
summary: The Bayesian and Akaike information criteria aim at finding a good balance between under- and over-fitting. They are extensively used every day by practitioners. Yet we contend they suffer from at least two afflictions: their penalty parameter $λ=\log n$ and $λ=2$ are too small, leading to many false discoveries, and their inherent (best subset) discrete optimization is infeasible in high dimension. We alleviate these issues with the pivotal information criterion: PIC is defined as a continuous optimization problem, and the PIC penalty parameter $λ$ is selected at the detection boundary (under pure noise). PIC's choice of $λ$ is the quantile of a statistic that we prove to be (asymptotically) pivotal, provided the loss function is appropriately transformed. As a result, simulations show a phase transition in the probability of exact support recovery with PIC, a phenomenon studied with no noise in compressed sensing. Applied on real data, for similar predictive performances, PIC selects the least complex model among state-of-the-art learners.

title: Lyapunov characterization of boundedness of reachability sets for infinite-dimensional systems
summary:
We prove a converse Lyapunov theorem for boundedness of reachability sets for a general class of control systems whose flow is Lipschitz continuous on compact intervals with respect to trajectory-dominated inputs. We show that this condition is satisfied by many semi-linear evolution equations.
  For ordinary differential equations, as a consequence of our results, we obtain a converse Lyapunov theorem for forward completeness, without a priori restrictions on the magnitude of inputs.

title: Stable and Steerable Sparse Autoencoders with Weight Regularization
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are widely used to extract human-interpretable features from neural network activations, but their learned features can vary substantially across random seeds and training choices. To improve stability, we studied weight regularization by adding L1 or L2 penalties on encoder and decoder weights, and evaluate how regularization interacts with common SAE training defaults. On MNIST, we observe that L2 weight regularization produces a core of highly aligned features and, when combined with tied initialization and unit-norm decoder constraints, it dramatically increases cross-seed feature consistency. For TopK SAEs trained on language model activations (Pythia-70M-deduped), adding a small L2 weight penalty increased the fraction of features shared across three random seeds and roughly doubles steering success rates, while leaving the mean of automated interpretability scores essentially unchanged. Finally, in the regularized setting, activation steering success becomes better predicted by auto-interpretability scores, suggesting that regularization can align text-based feature explanations with functional controllability.

title: Bayesian Adversarial Privacy
summary: Theoretical and applied research into privacy encompasses an incredibly broad swathe of differing approaches, emphasis and aims. This work introduces a new quantitative notion of privacy that is both contextual and specific. We argue that it provides a more meaningful notion of privacy than the widely utilised framework of differential privacy and a more explicit and rigorous formulation than what is commonly used in statistical disclosure theory. Our definition relies on concepts inherent to standard Bayesian decision theory, while departing from it in several important respects. In particular, the party controlling the release of sensitive information should make disclosure decisions from the prior viewpoint, rather than conditional on the data, even when the data is itself observed. Illuminating toy examples and computational methods are discussed in high detail in order to highlight the specificities of the method.

title: Beyond Mixtures and Products for Ensemble Aggregation: A Likelihood Perspective on Generalized Means
summary: Density aggregation is a central problem in machine learning, for instance when combining predictions from a Deep Ensemble. The choice of aggregation remains an open question with two commonly proposed approaches being linear pooling (probability averaging) and geometric pooling (logit averaging). In this work, we address this question by studying the normalized generalized mean of order $r \in \mathbb{R} \cup \{-\infty,+\infty\}$ through the lens of log-likelihood, the standard evaluation criterion in machine learning. This provides a unifying aggregation formalism and shows different optimal configurations for different situations. We show that the regime $r \in [0,1]$ is the only range ensuring systematic improvements relative to individual distributions, thereby providing a principled justification for the reliability and widespread practical use of linear ($r=1$) and geometric ($r=0$) pooling. In contrast, we show that aggregation rules with $r \notin [0,1]$ may fail to provide consistent gains with explicit counterexamples. Finally, we corroborate our theoretical findings with empirical evaluations using Deep Ensembles on image and text classification benchmarks.

title: Graphs are focal hypergraphs: strict containment in higher-order interaction dynamics
summary: We introduce a taxonomy of interaction types and show that graphs are focal hypergraphs: every graph is canonically a focal hypergraph via its closed neighbourhood structure, and every graph dynamical model is a special case of the general hypergraph dynamical model. The central distinction is between \emph{focal} interactions, in which the interaction domain is defined relative to a designated reference node, and \emph{non-focal} interactions, in which all participants stand in equivalent structural relationship. Closed graph neighbourhoods are precisely focal hyperedges, so hyperedges generalise graph neighbourhoods by removing the focal constraint. This yields a strict three-level hierarchy: graph models $\subsetneq$ focal hypergraph models $\subsetneq$ general hypergraph models. Moreover, graph models do encode genuinely higher-order (many-body) interactions, in the sense that each node's update function may depend jointly on all members of its closed neighbourhood, but they remain a strict special case of the hypergraph dynamical model, not equivalent to it. We further show that universal encodings such as bipartite factor graphs are neutral with respect to this hierarchy, and that the symmetry condition of the hypergraph dynamical model -- often treated as an additional constraint relative to the graph model -- is in fact the dynamical definition of a non-focal interaction. The taxonomy is grounded in concrete phenomena from physics, biology, ecology, and social systems, and yields a principle of representational alignment: the choice between graph and hypergraph models should be governed by the type of interaction, not by a blanket preference for one formalism over the other.

title: Semi-Supervised Generative Learning via Latent Space Distribution Matching
summary: We introduce Latent Space Distribution Matching (LSDM), a novel framework for semi-supervised generative modeling of conditional distributions. LSDM operates in two stages: (i) learning a low-dimensional latent space from both paired and unpaired data, and (ii) performing joint distribution matching in this space via the 1-Wasserstein distance, using only paired data. This two-step approach minimizes an upper bound on the 1-Wasserstein distance between joint distributions, reducing reliance on scarce paired samples while enabling fast one-step generation. Theoretically, we establish non-asymptotic error bounds and demonstrate a key benefit of unpaired data: enhanced geometric fidelity in generated outputs. Furthermore, by extending the scope of its two core steps, LSDM provides a coherent statistical perspective that connects to a broad class of latent-space approaches. Notably, Latent Diffusion Models (LDMs) can be viewed as a variant of LSDM, in which joint distribution matching is achieved indirectly via score matching. Consequently, our results also provide theoretical insights into the consistency of LDMs. Empirical evaluations on real-world image tasks, including class-conditional generation and image super-resolution, demonstrate the effectiveness of LSDM in leveraging unpaired data to enhance generation quality.

title: FlowW2N: Whispered-to-Normal Speech Conversion via Flow-Matching
summary: Whispered-to-normal (W2N) speech conversion aims to reconstruct missing phonation from whispered input while preserving content and speaker identity. This task is challenging due to temporal misalignment between whisper and voiced recordings and lack of paired data. We propose FlowW2N, a conditional flow matching approach that trains exclusively on synthetic, time-aligned whisper-normal pairs and conditions on domain-invariant features. We exploit high-level ASR embeddings that exhibits strong invariance between synthetic and real whispered speech, enabling generalization to real whispers despite never observing it during training. We verify this invariance across ASR layers and propose a selection criterion optimizing content informativeness and cross-domain invariance. Our method achieves SOTA intelligibility on the CHAINS and wTIMIT datasets, reducing Word Error Rate by 26-46% relative to prior work while using only 10 steps at inference and requiring no real paired data.

title: Index and Robustness of Mixed Equilibria: An Algebraic Approach
summary: We present a new method for computation of the index of completely mixed equilibria in finite games, based on the work of Eisenbud et al.(1977). We apply this method to solving two questions about the relation of the index of equilibria and the index of fixed points, and the index of equilibria and payoff-robustness: any integer can be the index of an isolated completely mixed equilibrium of a finite game. In a particular class of isolated completely mixed equilibria, called monogenic, the index can be $0$, $+1$ or $-1$ only. In this class non-zero index is equivalent to payoff-robustness. We also discuss extensions of the method of computation to extensive-form games, and cases where the equilibria might be located on the boundary of the strategy set.

title: On Error Thresholds for Pauli Channels: Some answers with many more questions
summary: This paper focuses on error thresholds for Pauli channels. We numerically compute lower bounds for the thresholds using the analytic framework of coset weight enumerators pioneered by DiVincenzo, Shor and Smolin in 1998. In particular, we study potential non-additivity of a variety of small stabilizer codes and their concatenations, and report several new concatenated stabilizer codes of small length that show significant non-additivity. We also give a closed form expression of coset weight enumerators of concatenated phase and bit flip repetition codes. Using insights from this formalism, we estimate the threshold for concatenated repetition codes of large lengths. Finally, for several concatenations of small stabilizer codes we optimize for channels which lead to maximal non-additivity at the hashing point of the corresponding channel. We supplement these results with a discussion on the performance of various stabilizer codes from the perspective of the non-additivity and threshold problem. We report both positive and negative results, and highlight some counterintuitive observations, to support subsequent work on lower bounds for error thresholds.

title: Comparison theorems for the extreme eigenvalues of a random symmetric matrix
summary: This paper establishes a comparison theorem for the maximum eigenvalue of a sum of independent random symmetric matrices. The theorem states that the maximum eigenvalue of the matrix sum is dominated by the maximum eigenvalue of a Gaussian random matrix that inherits its statistics from the sum, and it strengthens previous results of this type. Corollaries address the minimum eigenvalue and the spectral norm. The comparison methodology is powerful because of the vast arsenal of tools for treating Gaussian random matrices. As applications, the paper improves on existing eigenvalue bounds for random matrices arising in spectral graph theory, quantum information theory, high-dimensional statistics, and numerical linear algebra. In particular, these techniques deliver the first complete proof that a sparse random dimension reduction map has the injectivity properties conjectured by Nelson & Nguyen in 2013.

title: SELDON: Supernova Explosions Learned by Deep ODE Networks
comments: Accepted at AAAI 2026 (Proceedings of the AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence)
summary: The discovery rate of optical transients will explode to 10 million public alerts per night once the Vera C. Rubin Observatory's Legacy Survey of Space and Time comes online, overwhelming the traditional physics-based inference pipelines. A continuous-time forecasting AI model is of interest because it can deliver millisecond-scale inference for thousands of objects per day, whereas legacy MCMC codes need hours per object. In this paper, we propose SELDON, a new continuous-time variational autoencoder for panels of sparse and irregularly time-sampled (gappy) astrophysical light curves that are nonstationary, heteroscedastic, and inherently dependent. SELDON combines a masked GRU-ODE encoder with a latent neural ODE propagator and an interpretable Gaussian-basis decoder. The encoder learns to summarize panels of imbalanced and correlated data even when only a handful of points are observed. The neural ODE then integrates this hidden state forward in continuous time, extrapolating to future unseen epochs. This extrapolated time series is further encoded by deep sets to a latent distribution that is decoded to a weighted sum of Gaussian basis functions, the parameters of which are physically meaningful. Such parameters (e.g., rise time, decay rate, peak flux) directly drive downstream prioritization of spectroscopic follow-up for astrophysical surveys. Beyond astronomy, the architecture of SELDON offers a generic recipe for interpretable and continuous-time sequence modeling in any time domain where data are multivariate, sparse, heteroscedastic, and irregularly spaced.
